entities.name: Rhindle
entities.description: Legendary massive scaled wurm of Fyndhorn with blue scales who threatened Jornstad.

entities.name: Finroy
entities.description: Attacked by Rhindle while dressed as Lord Rothchild; suffered a broken thigh.

entities.name: Lord Rothchild
entities.description: Lord of Jornstad who received credit despite not being present.

entities.name: Jornstad
entities.description: City on the border of Fyndhorn threatened by Rhindle.

events.summary: Rhindle attacks Finroy, clad as Lord Rothchild; the townsfolk attack the wurm until it retreats into the forest.
events.quote: the townsfolk attacked the wurm from all angles, until it retreated into the forest

relations.quote: threatening the city of Jornstad on the border of the forest
